packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

Keep the engines.bun floor out of the top-level rangeStrategy bump: under bump, Renovate opens a renovate/bun-1.x PR that raises ">=1.1.0" to the newest Bun on every release, which main never did. auto leaves a range the newest Bun already satisfies alone (#89).
